topIssues.title: op-node/derive: derivation pipeline external-input error handling audit
topIssues.author: sebastianst
topIssues.body:
## Summary

An audit of the derivation pipeline invariant: **malformed or bad external L1 inputs (batcher transactions, system config logs, deposit logs) must never halt derivation — they should be dropped and processing must continue. Only internal logic errors may produce `CriticalError`s.**

The invariant is broadly well-maintained. Several issues were identified, detailed in sub-issues linked below. This issue serves as the tracking parent.

## Pipeline stage order

```
L1Traversal → L1Retrieval → FrameQueue → ChannelMux(ChannelBank|ChannelAssembler)
  → ChannelInReader → BatchMux(BatchQueue|BatchStage) → AttributesQueue
```

## Findings summary

### ✅ Correctly handled

| Location | Trigger | Behavior |
|---|---|---|
| [`calldata_source.go`](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/blob/d25685cb6189c10907ec12ba6172ccbeb2cfb8ec/op-node/rollup/derive/calldata_source.go) / [`data_source.go`](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/blob/d25685cb6189c10907ec12ba6172ccbeb2cfb8ec/op-node/rollup/derive/data_source.go) | Invalid batcher tx (wrong sender, bad sig) | Silently filtered by `isValidBatchTx` |
| [`frame_queue.go:77-82`](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/blob/d25685cb6189c10907ec12ba6172ccbeb2cfb8ec/op-node/rollup/derive/frame_queue.go#L77-L82) | Bad frame parse | `Warn` log + drop (returns `nil`, not the error) |
| [`channel_bank.go:105-108`](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/blob/d25685cb6189c10907ec12ba6172ccbeb2cfb8ec/op-node/rollup/derive/channel_bank.go#L105-L108) | Bad frame ingest into channel | `Warn` log + drop |
| [`channel_assembler.go:110-114`](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/blob/d25685cb6189c10907ec12ba6172ccbeb2cfb8ec/op-node/rollup/derive/channel_assembler.go#L110-L114) | Bad frame add | `Warn` log + `continue` |
| [`l1_traversal.go:78-82`](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/blob/d25685cb6189c10907ec12ba6172ccbeb2cfb8ec/op-node/rollup/derive/l1_traversal.go#L78-L82), [`l1_traversal_managed.go:114-118`](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/blob/d25685cb6189c10907ec12ba6172ccbeb2cfb8ec/op-node/rollup/derive/l1_traversal_managed.go#L114-L118) | Malformed system config log | `Warn` log + continue |
| [`attributes.go:98-100`](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/blob/d25685cb6189c10907ec12ba6172ccbeb2cfb8ec/op-node/rollup/derive/attributes.go#L98-L100) | Malformed system config log | Silently ignored (`_ = ...`) |
| [`batches.go`](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/blob/d25685cb6189c10907ec12ba6172ccbeb2cfb8ec/op-node/rollup/derive/batches.go) / [`batch_queue.go`](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/blob/d25685cb6189c10907ec12ba6172ccbeb2cfb8ec/op-node/rollup/derive/batch_queue.go) / [`batch_stage.go`](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/blob/d25685cb6189c10907ec12ba6172ccbeb2cfb8ec/op-node/rollup/derive/batch_stage.go) | Invalid batch content | `BatchDrop` + `Warn` log, no error propagation |
| [`blob_data_source.go:68-72`](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/blob/d25685cb6189c10907ec12ba6172ccbeb2cfb8ec/op-node/rollup/derive/blob_data_source.go#L68-L72) | Failed blob-to-data conversion | Log + recursive `Next()` skip |
| [`altda_data_source.go:66-69`](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/blob/d25685cb6189c10907ec12ba6172ccbeb2cfb8ec/op-node/rollup/derive/altda_data_source.go#L66-L69) | Invalid AltDA commitment | `Warn` + `NotEnoughData` |
| [`channel_bank.go:Read()`](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/blob/d25685cb6189c10907ec12ba6172ccbeb2cfb8ec/op-node/rollup/derive/channel_bank.go#L117) | Channel timeout | Silent drop |

### ⚠️ Issues (sub-issues below)

1. [`channel_in_reader.go:83-86`](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/blob/d25685cb6189c10907ec12ba6172ccbeb2cfb8ec/op-node/rollup/derive/channel_in_reader.go#L83-L86) — channel decompression failure returns `NewTemporaryError` instead of dropping cleanly (#19492)
2. [`channel_in_reader.go:116-117`](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/blob/d25685cb6189c10907ec12ba6172ccbeb2cfb8ec/op-node/rollup/derive/channel_in_reader.go#L116-L117) — pre-Delta span batch returns `NewTemporaryError` creating O(N×backoff) slow drain for adversarial channels (#19493)
3. [`channel_in_reader.go:118-124`](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/blob/d25685cb6189c10907ec12ba6172ccbeb2cfb8ec/op-node/rollup/derive/channel_in_reader.go#L118-L124) — malformed span batch tx data (`DeriveSpanBatch` failure) propagates as unclassified error, also creating O(N×backoff) slow drain (#19494)
4. [`data_source.go:71-73`](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/blob/d25685cb6189c10907ec12ba6172ccbeb2cfb8ec/op-node/rollup/derive/data_source.go#L71-L73) — missing beacon endpoint after Ecotone activation returns unclassified error instead of `CriticalError` (#19495)

### ✅ Intentional exceptions to the invariant

- **[`attributes.go:92-96`](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/blob/d25685cb6189c10907ec12ba6172ccbeb2cfb8ec/op-node/rollup/derive/attributes.go#L92-L96)** — Malformed deposit log → `NewCriticalError`. Intentional: the `OptimismPortal` contract is trusted infrastructure; a malformed deposit event signals either a contract upgrade (new event version) or serious RPC corruption. Silently skipping it would mean silently losing user bridge funds. The comment documents this explicitly.
- **[`altda_data_source.go:87`](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/blob/d25685cb6189c10907ec12ba6172ccbeb2cfb8ec/op-node/rollup/derive/altda_data_source.go#L87)** — AltDA missing past window → `NewCriticalError`. Intentional: an on-chain commitment that can no longer be fulfilled is an unrecoverable state.

## Notes on [`channel_in_reader.go`](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/blob/d25685cb6189c10907ec12ba6172ccbeb2cfb8ec/op-node/rollup/derive/channel_in_reader.go) default batch type

The `default:` branch at line 126-128 (unknown batch type → `NewTemporaryError`) is unreachable in practice: `BatchData.decodeTyped` already returns an error for unknown type bytes, which is caught at the `cr.nextBatchFn()` call site (lines 92-98) and handled correctly via `cr.NextChannel()` + `NotEnoughData`.

---

topIssues.title: Implement `L2PayloadWitness` hint for interop
topIssues.author: pauldowman
topIssues.body:
The `L2PayloadWitness` hint allows `debug_executePayload` to be used instead of `debug_dbGet` in order to provide op-reth support. (Recent work has solved op-reth's historical state performance problems.)

Kona host supports `L2PayloadWitness` with the `--enable-experimental-witness-endpoint` arg, but it's not implemented for interop.

topIssues.title: op-supernode: BlockNumberToTimestamp should respect Genesis.L2.Number
topIssues.author: opsuperchain
topIssues.body:
## Summary
`simpleChainContainer.BlockNumberToTimestamp` computes timestamps as `Genesis.L2Time + blockNum * BlockTime`, which ignores `Genesis.L2.Number`. The canonical rollup helper already models the correct formula as `Genesis.L2Time + ((blockNumber - Genesis.L2.Number) * BlockTime)`.

## Why this matters
If a chain uses a nonzero L2 genesis block number, the current helper returns the wrong timestamp. In the supernode today, this primarily affects invalidation-triggered rewinds, because the rewind path converts block -> timestamp and then timestamp -> block again using the canonical rollup helper.

That means the current code can compute the wrong rewind target on nonzero-genesis configurations.

## Relevant code
- buggy helper: `op-supernode/supernode/chain_container/chain_container.go`
- canonical helper: `op-node/rollup/types.go` `TimestampForBlock()`
- affected path: `op-supernode/supernode/chain_container/invalidation.go` -> `RewindEngine()`

## Suggested fix
Use the canonical rollup helper for block-number-to-timestamp conversion and preserve validation at the chain-container layer.

## Notes
This issue is configuration-dependent: if `Genesis.L2.Number == 0`, the current formula happens to work. The bug appears when the genesis L2 block number is nonzero.

topIssues.title: op-supernode: consolidate duplicated BlockNumberToTimestamp helpers
topIssues.author: opsuperchain
topIssues.body:
## Summary
`simpleChainContainer` currently has two near-identical block-number-to-timestamp helpers with different failure semantics:
- exported `BlockNumberToTimestamp(ctx, blocknum) (uint64, error)`
- private `blockNumberToTimestamp(blockNum) uint64`

The private helper silently returns `0` when rollup config is unavailable, while the exported helper returns an error.

## Why this matters
This is a maintenance hazard and makes it easy for one path to drift from the other. It also hides configuration problems on the private path instead of surfacing them.

## Relevant code
- `op-supernode/supernode/chain_container/chain_container.go`
- current private call site: `op-supernode/supernode/chain_container/invalidation.go`

## Suggested fix
Consolidate these into a single validated conversion path and remove the silent-zero variant.

## Audit note
This came up during audit follow-up while reviewing supernode rewind logic.

topPRs.title: refactor: move OP EVM code into alloy-op-evm newtypes
topPRs.author: theochap
topPRs.body:
## Summary
- Introduce `OpTx` and `OpTxError` newtype wrappers in alloy-op-evm to hold all OP-specific EVM implementations previously in alloy-evm's `op` module
- Move spec ID mapping and `EvmEnv` constructors as free functions (`evm_env_for_op_block`, `evm_env_for_op_next_block`)
- Add `TryIntoTxEnv<OpTx>` for `OpTransactionRequest` behind `rpc` feature
- Add `TransactionEnv` impl for `OpTx` behind `reth` feature
- Update op-reth, kona, and custom-node example to use new types
- Remove `alloy-evm` `op` feature usage from kona crates

This is the companion PR to https://github.com/alloy-rs/evm/pull/312 which removes the OP-specific code from alloy-evm. Together they decouple alloy-evm from Optimism, using newtype wrappers to satisfy Rust's orphan rule.

## Test plan
- [x] `cargo clippy` passes with no warnings
- [x] `cargo test -p alloy-op-evm` — 24 tests pass
- [x] Full workspace `cargo check` passes
